decisions.reason: The compact trommel builds on the established BASIC 518, which already had a customer base, and screening is a core segment, so it likely meets aspirations despite thin recent evidence.
The AK flail shredder line was updated across all models to EU Stage V, a costly investment that signals it is a core product the firm keeps upgrading.
A sister grinder line was already withdrawn, which suggests the firm is pruning this segment under pressure, but the mobile grinder remained featured, so it is kept for now under closer scrutiny.
The CERON single-shaft pre-shredders are presented as setting benchmarks and have documented installations, so they appear to meet aspirations within the firm's core stationary business.
